prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to actual noise-corrected results.
No kind of change has been helpful yet, as no tests have won.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout to showcase the companion certificate prominently. (why: Adoption step drops conversion to 60.9% and takes a median duration of 89s (mean 1017s).)
1: [home, wait_info] Home Waiting Estimate & Notification: Display an estimated waiting timer and enable desktop notifications while the pet is initializing. (why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s, causing user drops during desktop pet generation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Data Protection Hint: Add a prominent explanatory hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in preserves pet customization across sessions. (why: Support received 8 separate emails reporting lost or reset pets after re-signing into the app.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Controls Guide Screen: Insert a clear desktop controls introduction screen after completing onboarding to explain pet interaction and visibility controls. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and multiple users wrote to support confused about how to hide or talk to their pet.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Path Selection Copy: Simplify headline and body copy on choose_path screen to clarify choices and reduce hesitation. (why: Path selection takes a high mean duration of 514s and loses 23.8% of users right at the beginning.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Guidelines Pre-Upload Screen: Introduce a photo guidelines sub-flow screen right before photo uploads to prevent custom generation errors. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or malformed output during photo adoption.)
6: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Notification: Configure desktop notification alerts when home welcome screen displays so users notice pet launch on screen. (why: Support received complaints about pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open visually.)
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Progress Indicator: Show onboarding step progress counter and progress bar during path selection. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low (17.8%), and showing step progress early sets clear completion expectations.)
8: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Split Screen Layout: Change sign-in screen to a split layout showcasing account benefits alongside sign-in options. (why: Sign in converts at 72.9% with 8 support issues tied to lost account pets.)
